long_biography.plain_text:
Lagasse trained as an engineer at the University of Lowell and spent three decades building Plastek, a plastics-molding manufacturer that employed about 500 people nationally. Alongside his wife, Ann, he also acquired, restored and managed historic mixed-use buildings and marinas in downtown Newburyport. The couple received local recognition for preservation and waterfront improvement before selling the manufacturing and property portfolios.

They founded Ocean Havens in 2007 to acquire, redevelop and operate distinctive waterfront properties. Their projects have combined marina infrastructure, public waterfront access, lodging and commercial space, often by rehabilitating distressed harbor sites. Lagasse remains a principal of the company and has continued expanding its New England marina network while serving on the board of the Center for Coastal Studies.
